dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures display irregular, non-circular perimeters with high-contrast, serrated edges. There is a sharp gradient transition from the dark charcoal exterior to a light-grey interior concentrated in the mid-flank region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-to-moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated along the upper dorsal ridge and near the posterior transition to the tail.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three large, prominent 'O' annuli on the lateral flank form an elongated obtuse triangle. Two smaller high-intensity blobs near the shoulder region form a line segment roughly parallel to the primary dorsal curvature.
